# team-msa_v2-gemini-3-8-flash-flash_10-stepcounter

<!-- Generated by tools/export_results.py. Edit only the Experiment and Observations sections. -->

## Experiment

`team` mode (a lead and a member, one feature each, sharing a task list and a shared folder; the lead integrates and submits) with `gemini-3.8-flash` at `high` thinking, 100 steps, compaction at 28K, and the per-turn step counter. It uses the same setup as `coop --git` with the counter (8/10), so the two can be compared directly.

## Observations

- 4/10, half of `coop --git` with the same setup (8/10), and below `team` with 250 steps and no counter (5/10).
- The lead ran out of steps much more often than the member: 6 of 10 leads used all 100 steps (3 of 10 members), and in `huggingface_datasets_task/6252` and `pallets_click_task/2800` the lead pushed nothing, so only the member's feature passed. The lead does its own feature plus the integration, so it has less budget for each.
- 2 pairs had merge conflicts (`go_chi_task/26`, `typst_task/6554`); `coop --git` passed `typst_task/6554`. In `dspy_task/8394` the member pushed nothing.
- No harness errors this time.
